arml-2019-superrelay-01.title: Add the equations
arml-2019-superrelay-01.body:
Adding: $c(b+d)=39$, so $c\mid39$ and $c\le39$. $c=39$ works with $b+d=1$, e.g. $b=0$, $d=1$, $a=20$ (check: $-20+39=19$ ✓).

**Answer: 39**

arml-2019-superrelay-02.title: All non-clubs
arml-2019-superrelay-02.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 1, which is 39.)*


Given no clubs, the set is a uniformly random $T$-subset of the 39 non-club cards; it contains the three non-club aces with probability $\binom{36}{T-3}/\binom{39}{T}$. With $T=39$ the set is all 39 non-clubs, so the probability is $1$.

**Answer: 1**

arml-2019-superrelay-03.title: Base and height
arml-2019-superrelay-03.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 2, which is 1.)*


Let $CD=3x$ and $h$ the distance between $AB$ and $CD$. $[ABCD]=3xh$ and $[MPQ]=\frac12\cdot x\cdot h$, so the ratio is $6$ (independent of $T$ and of where $M$ is on $AB$).

**Answer: 6**

arml-2019-superrelay-04.title: Common base
arml-2019-superrelay-04.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 3, which is 6.)*


$\log_T\sqrt{x-7}=\log_{T^2}(x-7)$, so the equation is $\log_{T^2}\big((x-7)(x-2)\big)=1$: $(x-7)(x-2)=36$, i.e. $x^2-9x-22=0=(x-11)(x+2)$. $x=-2$ makes $\sqrt{x-7}$ undefined, so $x=11$ (check: $\log_6 2+\log_{36}9=\log_62+\log_63=1$ ✓).

**Answer: 11**

arml-2019-superrelay-05.title: Stars and bars
arml-2019-superrelay-05.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 4, which is 11.)*


Terms have the form $c\,(px)^a y^b z^c$ with $a+b+c=T-1=10$: $N=\binom{12}2=66$ terms. A term is always a multiple of $p$ iff $a\ge1$; the terms with $a=0$ number $T=11$ ($b=0,\dots,10$). So $M=66-11=55$.

**Answer: 55**

arml-2019-superrelay-06.title: Either condition
arml-2019-superrelay-06.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 5, which is 55.)*


Geometric: $K=\frac{(T-5)^2}{20}=\frac{2500}{20}=125$. Arithmetic: $K=\frac{19+4T+11}2=2T+15=125$. Both give $K=125$.

**Answer: 125**

arml-2019-superrelay-07.title: Ratio √3
arml-2019-superrelay-07.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 6, which is 125.)*


If $\mathcal C_n$ has edge $s$, then $\mathcal S_n$ has diameter $s\sqrt3$, which is the edge of $\mathcal C_{n+1}$. Edges: $5,\ 5\sqrt3,\ 15,\dots$; volumes $125,\ 375\sqrt3\approx650,\ 3375$. The first volume $\ge2019$ is $3375$, edge $15$.

**Answer: 15**

arml-2019-superrelay-08.title: Split 100 km in ratio S : M
arml-2019-superrelay-08.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $S$ was the answer to problem 7 (15) and $M$ the answer to problem 9 (10).)*

They ride for the same time, so distances are in ratio $S:M=15:10$. Sam rides $\frac{100S}{S+M}=\frac{1500}{25}=60$ km.

**Answer: 60**

arml-2019-superrelay-09.title: Multiplication principle
arml-2019-superrelay-09.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 10, which is 210.)*


Dessert has $2+1=3$ options (including none), so $T=7\cdot K\cdot3=21K$ and $K=\frac{210}{21}=10$.

**Answer: 10**

arml-2019-superrelay-10.title: Sum of exponents
arml-2019-superrelay-10.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 11, which is 20.)*


The divisors are $2^0,2^1,\dots,2^T$, with product $2^{0+1+\dots+T}=2^{T(T+1)/2}$. $K=\frac{20\cdot21}2=210$.

**Answer: 210**

arml-2019-superrelay-11.title: Difference of squares
arml-2019-superrelay-11.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 12, which is $\frac1{40}$.)*


$x^2-y^2=(x+y)(x-y)=5(x-y)=\frac1T=40$, so $x-y=8$; with $x+y=5$, $x=\frac{13}2$, and $z=x+7=\frac{27}2$. So $x+z=20$.

**Answer: 20**

arml-2019-superrelay-12.title: Minimize a quadratic
arml-2019-superrelay-12.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 13, which is 20.)*


$[LEO]=\frac12\cdot\frac1T\cdot\frac1n\cdot(n^3-4n^2+5n)=\frac{n^2-4n+5}{2T}=\frac{(n-2)^2+1}{2T}$, minimized at $n=2$ with value $\frac1{2T}=\frac1{40}$.

**Answer: $\frac{1}{40}$**

arml-2019-superrelay-13.title: Expand
arml-2019-superrelay-13.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 14, which is 362.)*


$(K-20)(K+1)+19K-K^2=K^2-19K-20+19K-K^2=-20$, so the answer is $20$ (here $K=19$, but it doesn't matter).

**Answer: 20**

arml-2019-superrelay-14.title: Vieta
arml-2019-superrelay-14.body:
*(In the Super Relay, $T$ was the answer to problem 15, which is 400.)*


$a+b+c=20$, $ab+bc+ca=19$, so $a^2+b^2+c^2=400-38=362$ (independent of $T$).

**Answer: 362**

arml-2019-superrelay-15.title: Coordinates
arml-2019-superrelay-15.body:
Put $K=(0,0)$, $E=(20,0)$, $N=(20,20)$, $T=(0,20)$. The equilateral triangle on $EN$ inside the square has $M=(20-10\sqrt3,10)$. Then $KM^2=(20-10\sqrt3)^2+100=400-400\sqrt3+300+100=800-400\sqrt3$, so $b=400$.

**Answer: 400**
